limitations.curve: Native quote fees only; legacy nonzero base entitlement fails atomically without clearing either balance
limitations.lp: Official Burn & Earn CollectCpFees only, then exact claimed token delta swapped through receipt-bound CPMM and unwrapped
limitations.creator: Original ledger entitlement preserved; only new ATA deltas swapped; prior token and WSOL balances unchanged
limitations.slippage: minimum total native SOL > 0; failing swap/min-output rolls back collection, ledger and rent
limitations.twoFeeKeys: Same nonce/temp PDAs may close/reinitialize sequentially: LP1138bytes and creator1206bytes including compute price; both <1M CU
limitations.firstClaimRent: Creator route retains existing persistent ledger/ATA initialization rent; sol_out excludes rent and network fees
limitations.legacyInstructions: Legacy token fee claims remain callable by their FeeKey owner. A treasury-signed adoption permanently places only the Evolut FeeKey in program custody.
limitations.prefunding: All new temporary token accounts must start at zero; excessive native prefunding rejects atomically and a fresh nonce remains usable.
limitations.keeper: Existing operational signer attests the committed evolution milestone and quote. Contract enforces custody, budgets, nonce, allowed pool/mint, deadlines, reserve-derived output floor, impact, batch limits and atomic swap/burn. This is not a permissionless USD oracle.
limitations.recovery: Cold admin can pause then recover unspent reserves only to fixed treasury, cancelling remaining budgets. FeeKey stays in custody; burned tokens cannot be recovered.
limitations.attribution: Actual collected net fee SOL, not exact historical trade-slot attribution; bounded claims may defer remaining fees. Creator-fee dust remains owed until convertible.
limitations.platformToken: Not launched; its 10% stays reserved until cold admin selects a verified graduated target once.

buybacks.activation: Disabled by default. Owner initializes, enables custody paused, then resumes after backend checks. Existing coins opt in through treasury signature.
